Title: Two tournaments in Berkeley, California on January 20, 2018

Messages.Author: mjvtes521
Messages.Body: So I'm going to host two tournaments at Victory Point Cafe in Berkeley, California USA on Saturday, Jan. 20, 2018. Standard constructed. 2 rounds + Final as usual. Proxies allowed, Imbued discouraged. $5 entry fee for each tournament, plus Victory Point's $5 fee per person to play all day. Victory Point Cafe has booze and food! Anthology sets and eternal glory for each winner, Promos for all and some good rare card for each Finalist. Sorry I'm out of boosters. First will start at 10am. Second starts at 5:00pm. Email me at  if you're interested. www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/8822. www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/8823
